notes.title: 1.8.5 Live!
notes.notes:
Various performance and UX fixes.

[list]
[*]Mouse over fixes.
[*]Blocks for in progress operations don't increase when time has paused.
[*]Improved tolerance under load to prevent expired operations from building up.
[/list]

notes.title: Buzludzha Monument
notes.notes:
This release includes the addition of the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buzludzha_monument]Buzludzha Monument[/url] video and panels for more details. Materials are courtesy of the [url=https://buzludzha-project.com/en/?source=if]Buzludzha Project[/url]. The Buzludzha Monument, reimagined as the [url=https://docs.immersivefusion.com/Partner/Hall-of-Supporters/]Hall of Supporters[/url] in Immersive Fusion’s 3D/VR world, is a powerful symbol of renewal, bridging a historic vision of Application Performance Management (APM) with a revolutionary new approach.
